description: Supabase Authentication System - Replace cookie+localStorage auth with Supabase Auth (JWT tokens, email OTP, Google OAuth), maintain demo mode for hackathon judges
steps: 1. Create lib/auth-helpers.ts with functions: hashPassword(password), verifyPassword(password, hash), generateOTP() returns 6-digit code, storeOTP(email, code, expiresAt) in users table or separate otp_codes table, verifyOTP(email, code) checks validity and 15-min expiry
2. Update types/index.ts: change Session interface to include access_token, refresh_token, expires_at from Supabase; add OTPVerification type { email, code, expiresAt }

3. Create app/api/auth/register/route.ts POST endpoint: validates email/password/role/name, hashes password with bcryptjs, creates Supabase auth user with supabase.auth.signUp(), creates corresponding row in users table and creator_profiles or brand_profiles table, sends email OTP if email confirmation enabled (use Supabase built-in email), returns { user, session } or { message: 'Check email for verification' }

4. Create app/api/auth/login/route.ts POST endpoint: (1) Check for demo credentials first (same DEMO_CREDENTIALS array from current useSession.ts - brand@cinegen.demo, creator@cinegen.demo, all 18 creator emails with Demo@123), if match: create short-lived Supabase session for that user via admin client, return session token. (2) For non-demo: call supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(), return session

5. Create app/api/auth/verify-otp/route.ts POST endpoint: accepts { email, otp }, verifies OTP code and expiry, calls supabase.auth.verifyOtp() if using Supabase's OTP or custom verification logic, returns session tokens on success
6. Create app/api/auth/google/route.ts GET endpoint: redirects to supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google', options: { redirectTo: `${BASE_URL}/auth/callback` } }), handles OAuth flow
7. Create app/auth/callback/route.ts GET handler: Supabase OAuth callback handler using cookies, exchanges code for session, redirects to /dashboard

8. Completely rewrite hooks/useSession.ts: Replace localStorage with Supabase session management. useEffect listens to supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(), stores session in state. login(email, password) calls /api/auth/login then supabase.auth.setSession(). loginAsRole(role) for demo mode calls login with demo credentials. logout() calls supabase.auth.signOut(). Remove switchRole (no longer needed - users have fixed roles). Add refreshSession() that calls supabase.auth.refreshSession(). Add loading state during initial auth check.

9. Update middleware.ts: Replace cookie role check with JWT verification using createServerClient from @supabase/ssr, extract role from users table join or from JWT custom claims, protect same routes (/dashboard, /briefs/new for brands only)

10. Update app/login/page.tsx: Keep existing demo login UI (Continue as Brand, Continue as Creator buttons call loginAsRole), add Google OAuth button that redirects to /api/auth/google, add email/password form that calls login() from useSession

11. Update app/register/page.tsx: Replace localStorage registration with API call to /api/auth/register, handle email verification flow (show 'Check your email' message), add OTP input field if email verification enabled, call /api/auth/verify-otp

12. Test demo mode thoroughly: brand@cinegen.demo, creator@cinegen.demo, and all 18 creator emails (aryan@cinegen.demo, priya@cinegen.demo, etc.) must still work with Demo@123 password for instant judge access
acceptance_criteria: Demo login still works: brand@cinegen.demo and creator@cinegen.demo with Demo@123 password logs in instantly via /api/auth/login
All 18 creator demo accounts (aryan@cinegen.demo through ishaan@cinegen.demo) work with Demo@123
New user registration creates Supabase auth user + database user row + profile row, sends verification email
Email OTP verification flow works (6-digit code, 15-minute expiry)
Google OAuth login redirects correctly and creates user session
JWT tokens are stored and refreshed properly, middleware correctly protects routes using Supabase session
Logout clears Supabase session and redirects to login
useSession hook provides session state across all components without localStorage
verification: Run: npm run build - must succeed with no TypeScript errors
Start dev server: npm run dev
Test demo login: go to /login, click 'Continue as Brand', verify redirect to /dashboard with brand stats visible
Test creator demo: click 'Continue as Creator', verify creator dashboard shows proposal stats
Test manual login: try aryan@cinegen.demo / Demo@123, verify login works
Test logout: click logout in navbar, verify redirect to login page and session cleared
Test new registration: register new brand user, verify email OTP flow (check Supabase email logs), verify login after verification
Test middleware protection: try accessing /dashboard without login, verify redirect to /login
